title: Island Nations
intro: Countries made of islands, with no land border. Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has no land border and lies wholly on islands?
questions.explain: Natural Earth records no land boundary between Japan and any other state; its territory is entirely islands.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT an island nation?
questions.explain: Kenya shares land borders with several neighbours, while Fiji, Cuba and Samoa have none.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Malta?
questions.explain: Valletta is the capital of Malta.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Fiji?
questions.explain: Suva is the capital of Fiji.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Cuba?
questions.explain: Havana is the capital of Cuba.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explain: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of the Philippines?
questions.explain: Manila is the capital of the Philippines.

questions.prompt: Which of these island nations has the largest area?
questions.explain: Natural Earth outlines give Madagascar about 595000 km2, ahead of Cuba at about 110000 km2.

questions.prompt: Which of these island nations is in Africa?
questions.explain: In the UN geoscheme Madagascar is in Africa, Cuba in the Americas, Fiji in Oceania and Japan in Asia.

questions.prompt: Which of these island nations is in Oceania?
questions.explain: In the UN geoscheme Fiji is in Oceania, Iceland in Europe, Cuba in the Americas and Sri Lanka in Asia.

questions.prompt: Which island nation has the most people?
questions.explain: Natural Earth lists the Philippines at over 100 million people (2019 estimate), far above the others.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Mauritius?
questions.explain: Port Louis is the capital of Mauritius.
